assertions.text: Says that each webhook gets a payloadGeneration setting, DEFERRED by default or IMMEDIATE, letting it opt out of deferred payload generation.
Says that an IMMEDIATE webhook on a deferrable event has its subscription payload built right away by whatever triggered the event, rather than in the deferred background task.
Says that deferred payloads reflect object state when the task runs, so consumers needing the state as written by each request, like sequential metadata updates, need IMMEDIATE.
Says that IMMEDIATE webhooks pay the payload-building cost in the triggering request or task, slowing it, while deferred keeps latency low.
Says that payloadGeneration can be set through the webhook create and update GraphQL mutations and through the app manifest, and is exposed on the Webhook type.
Does not claim that IMMEDIATE makes every async webhook or event build its payload inline, or that the default behavior of existing webhooks changed.
Does not claim that changing payloadGeneration alters the payload generation of deliveries or deferred tasks that already exist.
